title: Platelet Count（PC）/Spleen Diameter(SD) Ratio to Predict the Variceal Haemorrhage in HBV Cirrhotic Patients in China
brief_summary: To validate the PC/SD ratio to be used to predict the variceal haemorrhage in Chinese patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-associated hepatic cirrhosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with a diagnosis of HBV hepatic cirrhosis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with hepatocellular carcinoma,
* use of medications for the primary prophylaxis of variceal bleeding,
* history of esophageal variceal bleeding,
* alcohol consumption within the admission and a history of ligation,
* sclerotherapy, and/or
* portal hypertension surgery
